name: THE FIDDLER
note: Doc 07 #11. 'The Nugget. Tuned to the flat piano, therefore flat. Corrects first in Act IV.' He stands by the piano with his fiddle. HIS BARKS ARE ALL PLAYING (doc 07: 'mostly just playing'): none is a spoken line, so his file has none, and what doc 07 writes for R_BORDERS_MOTT, R_DEAD and R_TRUTH -- something faster, the passing tune, the A tuned in F2 -- is music, not yet made (errata 110). Doc 22: he idles in time with the bar grid.
barksNote: Doc 07 §11 writes him three barks and all three are directions -- playing -- not words; none is a bark a balloon can carry (errata 110).

sprite.frameNote: HE KEEPS TIME WITH THE PIANO (doc 22: the fiddler idles in time with the musical bar grid; errata 116): `keepsTime` reads the Nugget bed's own position at its tempo, 152, so 0, the bow out at the start of the stroke, and 1, drawn across to its end, alternate once a beat, and a break comes every twelve bars (18.95 s), on a bar line. 2 mid-stroke, for a busier passage in the second break; 3 TUNE, the fiddle at his chest, a peg turned -- the first break; 4 TALK, fiddle and bow lowered.
sprite.figureHeightNote: Crown to sole (errata 112 L), the brim read by eye from the rest frame's row widths: tools/art/figure-height.py --hat took the fiddle at his chin for the brim (errata 115).
